name: Locust bean gum
aliases: E410, locust bean gum, carob bean gum, carob gum, LBG, goma de algarrobo, goma garrofín, gomme de caroube
what_is: A galactomannan-rich gum obtained from the endosperm of carob tree seeds and used mainly as a thickener, stabiliser and gelling aid.
why_botia: Locust bean gum is obtained from the seed of the carob tree. It thickens and stabilises, and in ice cream it prevents ice crystals from forming — which is why it is found in almost all of them. The body does not digest it.
can_1: Identify E410, locust bean gum or carob bean gum when declared on the label.
can_2: Trigger the E-number and texture information layers.
cannot_1: Determine the amount used when the label does not state a quantity.
cannot_2: Determine the exact grade, purification process or botanical batch from the ingredient name alone.
